content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. Type checking shows no errors in it. The only errors `tsc` printed are in the original `src/module.ts`, which can't resolve `lodash`.

- **`publicFields`:** `pick` now comes from `es-toolkit`, called the same way as before.
- **`totalAge`:** `sumBy` now comes from `es-toolkit`. It takes a function instead of the `'age'` string, so I added the small adapter `(row) => row.age`.
- **`parseAmount`:** `es-toolkit` has no `toNumber`, so this uses the one from `es-toolkit/compat`. The plain version would be `Number(text)`. That differs from lodash on edge cases such as `0b1`, so I kept the library call. I ran the compat version on a few inputs from your range. It gives 31 for `"0x1f"`, 12 for `" 12 "`, 0 for an empty string and NaN for `"1e"`, which are the values I expect from lodash's `toNumber`.

`npm run size -- out/module.ts` reports 267 bytes (min+gzip), of which 101 bytes are my own code. I couldn't get a baseline number for the original: `src/module.ts` fails to bundle here because `lodash` isn't installed, so I haven't compared the 101 bytes against it. I also didn't compare outputs against lodash directly, for the same reason.

I installed nothing and created no other source files.
